title: UPCAST
narration: Meet UPCAST. We learn factorized world transitions for geometry-aware video generation. The idea is simple: learn structure and appearance together, then transfer their benefits into a video backbone that generates on its own.

title: Geometry is not the whole visual state.
narration: A geometric representation describes the layout and correspondence of a scene. But a future image also needs color, texture, and lighting. We therefore treat geometry and video as complementary learned views of the same RGB observations, rather than asking geometry alone to explain everything.

title: Two predictive roles. One visual future.
narration: UPCAST learns a shared, discrete physical state, and a private, continuous appearance state. A geometry-anchored codebook gives physical transitions a common vocabulary. Invertible coupling learns how the two states interact to support the visual prediction. Geometry reconstruction reads the physical state alone.

title: Learn from the same future.
narration: During training, PAGE four D supplies geometric features, while DINO and the video backbone supply visual evidence. Video, geometry, and fused physical branches use the same residual quantizer. The appearance path stays continuous. Each branch reconstructs the same future, conditioned on the current anchor and time interval.

title: Teach. Select. Consolidate.
narration: The difference between fused and video-only physical codes conditions a teacher. Selective distillation transfers lower-error teacher predictions when the training signal is valid. We then refine the student on generated history, preparing the backbone for autoregressive generation.

title: Generate with the backbone alone.
narration: At inference, only the consolidated video backbone remains. The geometry encoder, appearance encoder, codebook, and conditioner are removed. Here are reference and generated videos under matched initial frames and camera trajectories.

title: Better long-horizon video quality.
narration: On one hundred matched sixty-four-frame rollouts, UPCAST reaches an F V D of four hundred ninety-seven point eight, and a JEDi score of three point eight eight. Compared with Geometry Forcing, these are reductions of six point nine and eleven point eight percent. P S N R improves by one point five decibels.

title: The gains survive consolidation.
narration: A matched training-stage analysis evaluates every checkpoint using only the backbone. Unified-space learning already improves all reported metrics over the original model. Consolidation further improves visual fidelity and JEDi, although F V D increases. Rollout refinement brings a smaller additional improvement.

title: Preserve geometry and visual fidelity.
narration: Zero-shot evaluation on ARKitScenes uses sensor-referenced geometry. On twelve matched clips, UPCAST improves depth error and point-cloud recall, while Geometry Forcing retains lower Chamfer distance and higher pose recall. The results reflect complementary geometric and visual priorities, rather than uniform geometric superiority.

title: Learn together. Generate alone.
narration: UPCAST organizes complementary knowledge during training, without adding auxiliary modules at inference. Explore the interactive method, matched videos, complete results, and training analysis on our project page.
